_doc: check_empty_scope.py: which gates may report success over a repo with no content.
legitimate = it SHOULD pass on nothing, and the reason says why.
known_blind = a real defect awaiting a guard. SHRINK-ONLY: never add to this list;
a gate that gains a guard is deleted from it, and the sweep fails if a listed gate
starts failing (a stale excuse is permission nobody needs).

legitimate.check_estate_corpus.py: its subject is the CONSUMER ESTATE, not the tree it is invoked in: it copies real subtrees out of other repos into a temp directory and never reads this repo at all, so a tree with no content cannot blind it. Not a silence -- every entry that could not be measured is named and counted in the summary, and an estate that is not on this machine reads 0/N verified, not N/N
legitimate.check_no_conflict_markers.py: a repo with no tracked files genuinely has no conflict markers, and there is no baseline to contradict: this gate has no population to lose
legitimate.check_no_emoji.py: it scans every tracked file and its scan set IS its subject, so it cannot be partially blind; a git failure now RAISES rather than returning an empty list (_gitutil.listed_files, 2026-09-05), which was the real hole
legitimate.check_no_home_paths.py: same shape as check_no_emoji and check_no_secrets -- the scan set IS the subject (every tracked text file), so it cannot be partially blind; over ZERO files it refuses outright, and a two-file tree with no home path is genuinely clean
legitimate.check_no_secrets.py: same shape as check_no_emoji -- scan set is the subject, and the silent-empty-on-git-failure hole is closed in _gitutil.listed_files
